summary: One church, Our Lady of Calvary, Knights Road. Weekend, weekday 8:00 AM and Saturday confession times agree in both November issues and on the website; a dated 6 PM Mass on Sun Nov 22 opens Forty Hours. Open: a Saturday 6:30 AM Mass (box says Mon-Sat, intentions and website say no), the website's September-June season for the weekday 6:30 AM, and whether to record the Forty Hours, whose exposition hours aren't printed.

sources.said: FORTY HOURS - Our Lady of Calvary Parish will begin our 40 Hours on Sunday, November 22 at 6:00PM. There will be a signup sheet to spend an hour with our Lord. 40 Hours will continue on Monday, November 23 at 7:00PM and Tuesday, November 24 at 7:30PM.

FORTY HOURS - Our Lady of Calvary Parish will begin our 40 Hours on Sunday, November 22 at 6:00PM. There will be a signup sheet to spend an hour with our Lord. 40 Hours will continue on Monday, November 23 at 7:00PM and Tuesday, November 24 at 7:30PM.
40 Hours begins on Sunday evening, November 22 at 6:00 PM Mass. Continues with evening prayer on Monday, November 23 at 7:00 PM and the closing on Tuesday, November 24 at 7:30 PM.

slots.rationale: R30: Forty Hours is Adoration, but neither issue (22acb5f5 p3, d9c589f9 p3) nor the website prints the hours of exposition: only 'begin our 40 Hours on Sunday, November 22 at 6:00PM' (the website: 'at 6:00 PM Mass', recorded as its own slot), Monday's 7 PM evening prayer and Tuesday's 7:30 PM closing. Option 'Printed start times' takes the printed 6:00PM as the start (gpt-6-luna's reading), though it overlaps the opening Mass. Option 'Evening starts only' times Sunday 1 hour after the 6 PM Mass (POLICY Times). Neither records an end. Leaning per precedent our-lady-of-consolation-parkesburg s13 (leave out a Forty Hours whose hours aren't printed). The dates are past, so the choice has little effect on the site.
